bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
ids="$(docker ps -q --filter label=com.docker.compose.service=videobot-poll)"
test "$(printf '%s\n' "$ids" | sed '/^$/d' | wc -l)" -eq 1 || { echo VIDEO_POLLER_NOT_SINGLE; exit 71; }
id="$ids"
image="$(docker inspect -f '{{.Config.Image}}' "$id")"
expected="create-videobot:video-ui-be4f34d"
test "$image" = "$expected" || { echo VIDEO_IMAGE_NOT_APPLIED; exit 72; }
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' "$id")" = true || { echo VIDEO_POLLER_NOT_RUNNING; exit 73; }
running="$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Status}}' "$id")"
restarts="$(docker inspect -f '{{.RestartCount}}' "$id")"
actual_id="$(docker inspect -f '{{.Image}}' "$id")"
image_id="$(docker image inspect -f '{{.Id}}' "$expected")"
test "$actual_id" = "$image_id" || { echo VIDEO_IMAGE_ID_MISMATCH; exit 74; }
printf 'VIDEO_POLLER_COUNT=1\nVIDEO_IMAGE_TAG=%s\nVIDEO_RUNNING=%s\nVIDEO_RESTART_COUNT=%s\nVIDEO_RUNTIME_READBACK=PASS\n' "$image" "$running" "$restarts"
